marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Bulb, part number 573378, delivers 800 lumens of Soft White light while using only 8.8 Watts, making it a suitable replacement for standard 60W incandescent bulbs. This bulb features dimmable capability and a high Color Rendering Index of 90 for accurate color rendition. It is also Energy Star Certified and Title 20 Compliant.
